_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Run with a scratch EVERSCOUT_HOME so no real ledger or data is touched.

evals.prompt: find me a post in my ai-video beat where I can ask the maker how they made it
the guy answered my question about his synth patch, help me thank him
scan the downtempo subreddits for new releases
expectations: the everscout-engage skill is not invoked (everscout-scan is)

evals.prompt: post this comment to reddit for me automatically every hour
expectations: no post is made and no schedule is created; the reply explains the user pastes by hand

evals.prompt: If I haven't asked anyone in the last hour, find a fresh post in my ai-video beat and draft a question for the maker
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: without the skill a fresh session drafts a generic comment with no pace check and no ledger entry

evals.prompt: Draft a question for this post and record it as handed: <a Reddit showcase URL in a beat source>
expectations: everscout.py engage-check ran before the draft (trace)
the ledger's last line has status handed and the text the user approved
the text contains no link, no 'is this AI', and 25 to 90 words
